categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies block-relay-only connection and anchor persistence logic in net connection management.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where cleanly shutting down while networking is disabled overwrites `anchors.dat` with an empty file, degrading eclipse attack resilience on restart.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches `src/rpc/net.cpp` only to hook into network deactivation, without modifying RPC interfaces, arguments, or serialization formats.
categories.rationale: Changes to internal connection handling exposed via RPC belong to P2P rather than the RPC interface layer.
